export interface AnyFailure<C extends string = string> {
    readonly code: C;
    readonly message: string;
}
export interface AnyInputFailure<C extends string = string> extends AnyFailure<C> {
    readonly field: string;
}
export const CommonErrorCodes: { readonly VALIDATION_FAILED: "VALIDATION_FAILED"; readonly INTERNAL: "INTERNAL"; }

export const ErrorCodeRegistry: Token<ErrorCodeSet<string>>
export interface ErrorCodeSet<C extends string> {
    readonly codes: {
        readonly [K in C]: K;
    };

    readonly internal: NoInfer<C>;
}
export type Failure<C extends string, D extends object = Record<never, never>> = Readonly<{
    code: C;
    message: string;
} & D>;
export type InputFailure<C extends string, D extends object = Record<never, never>> = Failure<C, {
    field: string;
} & D>;

  constructor(code: string, message: string, details?: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): PermanentError
  cause?: unknown

  message: string

export type RetryClass = 'permanent' | 'transient';

  constructor(code: string, message: string, details?: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): TransientError

    operation: string;
    cause?: unknown;
}>;
